tool_input.command: ls -la data/ submission/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---HELP---"; hops --help 2>&1 | head -60
tool_input.description: List data, submission dirs and CLI help

tool_input.command: echo "=== training_sample.csv ==="; head -5 data/training_sample.csv; echo; wc -l data/training_sample.csv; echo "=== serving_log.csv ==="; head -5 data/serving_log.csv; echo; wc -l data/serving_log.csv
hops sql --help 2>&1 | head -40; echo "===FG==="; hops fg --help 2>&1 | head -40
hops fg create --help 2>&1 | head -50; echo "===INSERT==="; hops fg insert --help 2>&1 | head -50
hops context --json 2>&1 | head -30
hops fg create skew_train --primary-key entity_id --features "entity_id:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double,f5:double" --if-exists get --json 2>&1 | tail -20
hops fg create skew_serve --primary-key entity_id --features "entity_id:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double,f5:double" --if-exists get --json 2>&1 | tail -20
hops fg insert skew_train --file data/training_sample.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -8
hops fg insert skew_serve --file data/serving_log.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -8
hops sql "SHOW TABLES" --json 2>&1 | tail -30
hops sql --no-verify "SHOW TABLES" --json 2>&1 | tail -30
hops sql --no-verify "SHOW SCHEMAS" --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v Warning | tail -30
hops sql --no-verify --schema mlpabac4de3_featurestore "SHOW TABLES" --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v Warning | grep -v "Logged in" | grep -v "ensure compat" | tail -30

hops sql --no-verify --schema mlpabac4de3_featurestore "SELECT count(*) AS n_train, (SELECT count(*) FROM skew_serve_1) AS n_serve, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT t.entity_id FROM skew_train_1 t JOIN skew_serve_1 s ON t.entity_id=s.entity_id)) AS n_join FROM skew_train_1" --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v Warning | grep -v "Logged in" | grep -v "ensure compat" | tail -10

hops sql --no-verify --catalog hive --schema mlpabac4de3_featurestore "SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM skew_train_1) AS n_train, (SELECT count(*) FROM skew_serve_1) AS n_serve, (SELECT count(*) FROM skew_train_1 t JOIN skew_serve_1 s ON t.entity_id=s.entity_id) AS n_join" --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v Warning | grep -v "Logged in" | grep -v "ensure compat" | tail -10
hops trino catalogs --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v Warning | grep -v "Logged in" | grep -v "ensure compat" | tail -20
hops sql --no-verify "SHOW CATALOGS" --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v Warning | grep -v "Logged in" | grep -v "ensure compat" | tail -20

hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpabac4de3_featurestore "SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM skew_train_1) AS n_train, (SELECT count(*) FROM skew_serve_1) AS n_serve, (SELECT count(*) FROM skew_train_1 t JOIN skew_serve_1 s ON t.entity_id=s.entity_id) AS n_join" --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v Warning | grep -v "Logged in" | grep -v "ensure compat" | tail -10

hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpabac4de3_featurestore "
SELECT
  avg(abs(t.f1-s.f1)) d1, max(abs(t.f1-s.f1)) m1,
  avg(abs(t.f2-s.f2)) d2, max(abs(t.f2-s.f2)) m2,
  avg(abs(t.f3-s.f3)) d3, max(abs(t.f3-s.f3)) m3,
  avg(abs(t.f4-s.f4)) d4, max(abs(t.f4-s.f4)) m4,
  avg(abs(t.f5-s.f5)) d5, max(abs(t.f5-s.f5)) m5
FROM skew_train_1 t JOIN skew_serve_1 s ON t.entity_id=s.entity_id" --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v Warning | grep -v "Logged in" | grep -v "ensure compat" | tail -15
tool_input.description: Mean and max abs diff per feature

tool_input.command:
hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpabac4de3_featurestore "
SELECT
  avg(t.f5) avg_train, avg(s.f5) avg_serve,
  min(t.f5) min_train, min(s.f5) min_serve,
  max(t.f5) max_train, max(s.f5) max_serve,
  corr(t.f5, s.f5) corr_f5,
  avg(s.f5 - t.f5) avg_signed_diff,
  avg(s.f5 / t.f5) avg_ratio
FROM skew_train_1 t JOIN skew_serve_1 s ON t.entity_id=s.entity_id" --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v Warning | grep -v "Logged in" | grep -v "ensure compat" | tail -15

hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpabac4de3_featurestore "
SELECT
  corr(t.f5, ln(s.f5)) corr_train_vs_lnserve,
  avg(t.f5 - ln(s.f5)) avg_diff_ln,
  max(abs(t.f5 - ln(s.f5))) max_diff_ln,
  corr(s.f5, exp(t.f5)) corr_serve_vs_exptrain,
  max(abs(s.f5 - exp(t.f5))) max_diff_exp
FROM skew_train_1 t JOIN skew_serve_1 s ON t.entity_id=s.entity_id" --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v Warning | grep -v "Logged in" | grep -v "ensure compat" | tail -15

hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpabac4de3_featurestore "
SELECT
  max(abs(s.f5 - (exp(t.f5)-1))) max_diff_expm1,
  avg(abs(s.f5 - (exp(t.f5)-1))) avg_diff_expm1,
  max(abs(t.f5 - ln(s.f5+1))) max_diff_log1p
FROM skew_train_1 t JOIN skew_serve_1 s ON t.entity_id=s.entity_id" --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v Warning | grep -v "Logged in" | grep -v "ensure compat" | tail -10
